domains.title: RF Signal Identification
domains.description: Automatically identifying and categorizing received RF signals — modulation type, waveform family and signal class — directly from raw I/Q samples.

domains.title: UAV Detection
domains.description: Detecting, localizing and recognizing unmanned aerial vehicles from their RF emissions, including per-device RF fingerprinting.

domains.title: Deep Learning for RF
domains.description: Designing CNN, ResNet and Transformer architectures that turn raw I/Q and time–frequency representations into reliable signal decisions.

domains.title: Robust Recognition
domains.description: Keeping classifiers accurate under low SNR, channel fading, hardware impairment and the distribution shift between lab and field captures.

publications.title: Deep Learning for Automatic Modulation Classification of RF Signals
publications.imageAlt: IQ constellation diagram with modulation clusters and a learned decision boundary
publications.summary: Ongoing work on convolutional and transformer models that classify the modulation type of received RF signals from raw I/Q samples, with an emphasis on robustness at low SNR.

publications.title: RF-Based Detection and Recognition of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publications.imageAlt: RF spectrogram showing a narrowband UAV control-link signature
publications.summary: Ongoing work on detecting and identifying small UAVs from their RF emissions using software-defined radio captures and deep classifiers, including RF fingerprinting of individual devices.

projects.title: RF Signal Classification & UAV Detection
projects.description: Deep-learning pipelines for automatic modulation classification and RF-based detection and fingerprinting of UAVs, built on software-defined radio captures.

projects.title: SDR RF Signal Capture Set
projects.description: An in-progress collection of software-defined radio captures spanning multiple modulation types and UAV emitters, used to train and evaluate signal classifiers.
